messages:
Anya: quick check — customers are pressing on perf next quarter. FinAssist wants sub-100ms tail for chat, EduFlow cares about throughput for bulk embeddings. We need a prioritization call: do we focus on latency-critical paths first or throughput/cost optimizations?
Sam: my vote is split. high-level: split into two tracks but prioritize customer-impacted latency wins first. small wins: kernel tweaks, smarter routing, caching.
Devon: agree on two tracks but suggest we score initiatives by impact-per-hour (impact / eng-effort) not just RICE. RICE sometimes hides unit-cost econ.
Mia: +1. also add launch criteria and guardrails up front. for latency work: 95p < 120ms at 50qps baseline, quality regression < 2% (eval set). for cost work: token cost reduction >= 20% without >10% latency regression.
Sam: example RICE-ish scoring I used last time:
```
reach = # of customers impacted
impact = % latency improvement on critical path
confidence = 0.0-1.0
effort = eng-weeks
score = (reach * impact * confidence) / effort
```
useful but we should convert impact into dollars saved or SLA risk reduction.
Anya: good point. customers with SLAs (FinAssist) carry multiplier. maybe weight reach by revenue tier.
Riley: Ops note — routing changes will require canary + fallback. canary rollout time ~2 days, watch autoscale metrics. ops-bot: canary deploy started (canary-42)
Devon: sequencing idea: 1) quick latency wins (routing/caching), 2) cost wins that are low-risk (batching for embeddings), 3) risky model-level changes (quant / new kernel) with feature-flagged rollouts. each step must include a pre/post eval and SLO smoke tests.
Mia: scope negotiation with customers: offer a staged SLA improvement plan. commit to 2 small latency wins in Q1, then broader infra work Q2. gets buy-in and reduces scope creep.
Sam: concrete proposal: pick top 3 candidate projects and score them with both RICE and impact-per-hour. share scores Tuesday, vote in sync on Wednesday.
Anya: PD: I'll compile a matrix. can people add estimated effort (t-shirt: S/M/L) to their proposals by EOD Monday? :thumbsup:
Devon: I'll add perf numbers and regression test plan.
Mia: I'll draft launch criteria and monitoring checklist.
Riley: ops will list canary/runbook constraints.
Anya: thanks — aim: decision by Wed PM so eng can plan sprint.
Sam: quick question — do we include Dedicated tenant optimizations in this prioritization or treat separately?
Mia: include them if customer-driven; otherwise we draft a Dedicated backlog parallel track.
Anya: noted. closing: will post the scoring template and a short rubric in #product-docs. if anyone has objections speak up now.
Devon: no objections.
ops-bot: reminder — post-candidate perf evals must include: 1) lat/throughput logs, 2) token-cost estimate, 3) regression eval snapshot.
